svg.title: Takaoka mark records for Koryo Kinjudo, Ginshodo and Shobee
svg.desc: Each maker card gives characters and romanization, location, method, date and context, producer-owned source, and confidence. Mark alone is not authentication.
svg.text: Characters/romanization · location · method · date/context · source · confidence

g.text: Koryo Kinjudo
高陵金寿堂 · Kōryō Kinjūdō / KORYOKINJUDO
Location: not verified
Method: not verified
Date/context: Meiji Kinjudo; early-Shōwa closure; name restored about 60 years later in Heisei
Source: current operator’s Koryo Kinjudo history; current Takaoka Tetsubin brand list
Confidence: name/revival first-party documented; mark range/pair absent; isolated device uncertain

Source: Ginshodo company, profile and iron-kettle pages
Confidence: current company identity documented; isolated device uncertain
